'''Paravacc 1.X''' was a [[Parasite/Legends|parasite]]-repelling vaccine developed by [[Uukaablian MedCorp]] on [[Uukaablis]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. The vaccine was contained in a polished metal cylinder, and administered by injection into the back of the neck. A mild [[Headache/Legends|headache]] occurred after injection. Prolonged use of the product (over three days at a time) was known to produce deleterious effects to the [[nervous system]].

The government of Uukaablis advertised to other worlds its willingness to trade the vaccine for more advanced technologies.
